reason: The launch price of $24.99 is a deal I can live with, and a named lab report I can scan on the box is more than most supplements give me. I would try one box, not commit to two, and see if I actually remember to take it.
objection: Sachets feel like more packaging waste, and I already forget my vitamins on the counter half the time, so I might not finish the 30 days.
would_change_my_mind: A bigger discount or coupon on the two-box deal, or a refill option that skips the single-use foil.
